actualResponse:
**I agree with the concrete prerequisite finding and select the bounded TAC-10 Undead actor/source/context SOURCE/API contract as the immediate next gate. Terrain runtime remains unapproved.** The Consecrate/Ground scope is sound, but the lawful actor, encounter context, finite route and several explicit API bindings still need completion.

I read the complete contract and verifier, independently rehashed all **129 pinned Git blobs**, reproduced the three lexical scans across **457 C# files**, reconciled the **67-entry census**, and checked the selected card extracts and archived RP7→0 witnesses. The engine tree is unchanged. I did not compile C#, execute gameplay or run the packet’s report-generating verifier. Its 30 reported passes remain source/API checks, not runtime qualification.

The immediate prerequisite is correctly placed under **TAC-10 ← TAC-03, TAC-04, TAC-05, TAC-02**. Keep **CHR-05 ← CHR-03, TAC-02, TAC-05, TAC-08** unchanged. Ferry-Wraith is an appropriate **candidate for operational review**, not an approved creature installation.

That contract must bind:

- **Non-class actor state:** source-qualified type membership, printed numerical facts, defenses, body/life/condition/death handling and every affected numerical consumer. `ActorLifeValidation` currently requires every actor to have a character record; merely permitting an empty level list would not complete that integration. Preserve mixed-type capability and explicit unknown classification.
- **Hellfire Claw:** preserve +3 and 1d4 fire. One wording correction: its **Actions heading does provide action context**. The missing complete operational binding especially concerns attack category and reach/range. Neither its name nor a differently scoped companion/form default supplies those automatically.
- **Contract-Bound:** actual seal/clause identity, empowered feature, lawful destruction or invalidation, suppression and exact endpoint. No omitted trait, invented object HP or free invalidation command.
- **Knowledge and control:** publication status does not reveal all creature facts to players or controllers. Preserve source knowledge boundaries and restricted decision projections.
- **Connected context:** fresh declared provenance, persistent placement, paid approach, actual source attack, shared consequences and lawful closure/continuation. No historical actor relabeling, mid-save insertion or inherited detached exception.

I found no already-admitted Undead attacker that avoids this prerequisite. Printed AC10 remains AC10; neither additional Strength damage, flight, incorporeality nor generic Undead immunities follows from the creature’s name or type.

The five terrain decisions are:

1. **CG-GEO-01 — approved with a source clarification.** Creation requires actual perception, range and line of effect to a supported ground point. The shared combat rules already require area-origin-to-target cover evaluation and exclusion through total obstruction; center-to-point effect blocking is therefore supported beyond the individual card text. Use the existing inclusive Chebyshev metric and exact fractional positions. Evaluate propagation from the **fixed zone center**, not the creator’s later location. Sight-only blockers remain distinct. Point perception must include actual observer restrictions such as Blinded/Unaware; a clear geometric ray alone is insufficient. No ongoing creator sight/range/consciousness requirement is added. [Shared targeting and area rules](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/46a4d52728ee6956f0bebcb5d2103ffd5bc67ba4/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md#cover-sight-hide-and-search)

2. **CG-GROUND-01 — approved as an explicit bounded interpretation.** Supported ground contact includes Prone. “Standing in terrain” does not impose an upright-posture requirement. Airborne, elevated and unsupported surface coverage remain unavailable pending their own bindings.

3. **CG-TIME-01 — approved as a NEW bounded classification.** Treat this mixed fixed zone as source-controlled: third future original source Start when created in initiative; application+18 seconds outside initiative. Preserve that deadline through epoch changes, removal and restoration. Expiry precedes tied recharge and voluntary activation. Movement, unconsciousness or death does not independently terminate this non-concentration fixed zone. Recharge retains its separate actual-owner cadence. Consecrate needs explicit versioned registration and validation: the existing cross-epoch recharge adapter specifically admits Invocation, not arbitrary ability IDs.

4. **CG-ORDER-01 — approved as a NEW explicit component order:** **base Rite → Ground → Radiance healing/cure → Aura**. Do not present this as printed canon or derive it dynamically from passive-acquisition or zone-creation timestamps. The generic application-order rule continues elsewhere.

5. **CG-STACK-01 — approved for these distinct restorations.** Ground, Radiance and Aura may each produce their separately restricted and capped recovery. They do not become a summed generic stat bonus or recursively trigger one another. Original positive base-Rite healing governs eligibility. Preserve Radiance’s once-own-turn limit, same-name exclusions and the absence of any approved multi-owner −2 penalty.

The amended contract must explicitly address the **real Radiance cure/history dependency**. `ValidateCureTrigger` currently requires current HP to equal the base Rite’s `HpAfter`; Ground-first healing changes that state. Preserve the base record’s meaning and add versioned causal intermediate values rather than deleting the check or counting Ground as Radiance. Aura must likewise validate its actual predecessor state. Include a cap witness where Ground fills the last missing HP, Radiance heals zero but still lawfully cures from the positive base trigger, and Aura heals zero.

Replacement also has a plausible candidate **without epoch transfer**: an outside activation partway through an owned interval can expire 18 seconds after activation while its third subsequent owner Start arrives slightly earlier. That may leave a paid replacement window. This is code-derived feasibility, not execution proof. At an exactly tied deadline, the old zone ends by **Expiry**, not Replacement.

Proceed with the **TAC-10 source/API contract preparation and review only**. Return any unresolved trait or physical interaction as a concrete prerequisite. After that capability is qualified, return the amended complete terrain contract with its genuine funding/context plan. No healing-only substitution, repeated Invocation proof or terrain runtime approval is granted here.

Whole-engine completion, P1 and production remain open. Unity remains deferred; storage cleanup and GitHub Support remain held.
